allow: PowerShell($shoes = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/shoes" -UseBasicParsing\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $id = $shoes.data[0].id; "Product ID: $id"; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3001/products/$id" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; "Has size buttons: " + \($r.Content -match "Talle"\); "Has PayPal CTA: " + \($r.Content -match "Comprar con PayPal"\); "Has model name: " + \($r.Content -match $shoes.data[0].model\))
